                                                                    1            Plaintiff Avnet, Inc. (“Avnet”) respectfully submits the following Complaint against

                                                                    2   Defendant Ampere Computing LLC (“Ampere”) and requests that the Court enter judgment in its

                                                                    3   favor and against Ampere.

                                                                    4                                          INTRODUCTION

                                                                    5            1.    This matter arises from an agreement between Plaintiff Avnet and Defendant

                                                                    6   Ampere relating to the purchase and distribution of computer processors and servers.

                                                                    7            2.    Specifically, in early 2021, Ampere was seeking ways to expand its revenues and

                                                                    8   market presence for its Altra processors, and came up with a strategy to issue purchase orders to

                                                                    9   original design manufacturers for barebone servers (L6) that could incorporate the Altra processors

                                                                   10   and then place those servers with original equipment manufacturers, system integrators, and end

                                                                   11   users.
SNELL & WILMER

                              LOS ANGELES, CALIFORNIA 90071-3420

                                   350 SOUTH GRAND AVENUE
                                     CITY NATIONAL 2CAL
                     LAW OFFICES

                                                                   13   large third-party original design manufacturer named Gigabyte.
            L.L.P.




                                                                   14            4.    Given that Ampere was a recently created company, Gigabyte was unwilling to

                                                                   15   fulfill Ampere’s desired purchase orders with favorable terms, leaving Ampere unable to

                                                                   16   accomplish its goals on its own.

                                                                   17            5.    Avnet is a longstanding company with a strong relationship with Gigabyte, and

                                                                   18   accordingly had much more favorable terms under which it could place purchase orders for the

                                                                   19   desired servers.

                                                                   20            6.    Ampere wanted to use Avnet’s relationship with Gigabyte to secure the server

                                                                   21   purchase orders that Ampere could not accomplish on its own.

                                                                   22            7.    Avnet was only willing to place the purchase orders and thereby incur the risk that

                                                                   23   the servers would not get placed and sold, if Ampere agreed to purchase from Avnet 75% of all

                                                                   24   completed servers that were not sold or placed within 90 days of delivery.

                                                                   25            8.    Avnet would not have purchased the servers for millions of dollars, nor placed a

                                                                   26   large $4 million order for Ampere Altra processors, without having Ampere agree to purchase 75%

                                                                   27   of unsold completed servers.

                                                                   25   accept Ampere’s POs.

                                                                   26          44.     Being thus unable to accomplish its marketing goals on its own, Ampere turned to

                                                                   27   Phoenics for assistance in placing Ampere’s POs with Gigabyte.
